_comment: Qwen3.5 checkpoints ship BF16 RMSNorm gains (Qwen3-family convention) — the metal gain-reader symbols must match. Qwen3.5 `*RMSNorm` stores zero-centered gains (`x * (1 + w)`); scratchy keeps the on-disk form and offsets in-kernel. The sparse-MoE router renormalizes top-k weights — newer configs omit `norm_topk_prob` and the modeling code defaults it TRUE. `Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration` nests the text decoder under `language_model.*` on disk.
